result.summary: Found 1 visual issue: overlapping/garbled delivery info text under the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card.

issues.description: Delivery metadata text under 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' is garbled and overlapping, reading as '25-30rdelivery' instead of separate time and fee values.
issues.suggestion: Fix the layout stacking for the metadata row so delivery time, delivery fee, and cuisine are rendered without overlap, e.g. '25-30 min • €0 delivery • Ramen' with proper spacing.
